components.text: The [color=yellow]Antenna [color]is a powerful machine that act like a waypoint in space.
[br] [br] How to use : [br] Place down a full rocket launchpad. Then right click the middle of the launchpad with the antenna. You can now configure your antenna.

[br] [br] How to configure : [br] You need to write the name of the antenna and you can configure if the antenna is public or private. A public antenna can be used by everyone, while a private antenna can only be used by the player who placed it and whitelisted players.

[br] [br] Whitelist players : [br] To whitelist players, you need to use a [ref=stellaris:items/friends_list] Friend List [ref]. Add your friends to your list and then right click the antenna with your [ref=stellaris:items/friends_list] Friend List [ref].
